    Module

    src/connector-ui/src/components/ui

    Layer ui · project connector-ui · UI components: 19

    Project navigation: connector-ui

    Overview 🤖

    Contains reusable UI components for the connector UI.

    Responsibilities. Provides a set of standardized UI components for building consistent and accessible user interfaces.

    Usage. Used by various parts of the connector UI to create consistent and accessible user interfaces.

    AI draft from the facts on this page; review it, then write the module's documentation yourself.

    Key components

    Component Kind Used by Summary
    HelpTooltip component 35 A small "?" affordance for explaining a non-obvious field, section, or concept in place — click (or Enter/Space) to open a short explanation, Escape or an outside click to dismiss. Content is plain semantic markup in the default slot (p/strong/code/ul); :slotted() below gives it consistent typography so call sites don't have to repeat utility classes every time.
    Button component 32 Standard button in four visual variants. While loading, it shows a spinner (hiding the icon slot) and is disabled; the default slot is the label.
    Icon component 29
    Alert component 18
    PageHeader component 13 Consolidates the "eyebrow + <h1> + trailing actions" block repeated (with minor drift) at the top of every list/detail view, so it converges on the --text-page-title token instead of each view picking its own text-xl/arbitrary-value heading size.
    Input component 12 Labelled text input bound with v-model (string or number), built on FieldShell. Wires aria-invalid and aria-describedby to the error or help text; the id is generated when not given.
    Card component 6
    ConfirmAction component 5 De-duplicates the "click Delete → inline Confirm/Cancel" pattern repeated across run-controls panels and definition list rows. Renders as a fragment (no wrapping element) so it drops straight into whatever flex row the trigger button already lived in — confirming swaps the trigger slot for a prompt + confirm/cancel pair in place, matching how each call site already laid things out.
